text:
anya: quick smoke run of SmoothAct + SmoothQuant (AWQ) on the 13B long-context build with 128k tokens. uploading artifacts now. initial take: FP8 run is surprisingly close to fp32 on short dialogs, but tails diverge; int8/gptq show larger accuracy deltas on arithmetic/recall prompts. attaching short logs below. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
devon: thanks — can you drop the s3 link and the exact eval command?
anya: s3://redwood-inference/experiments/1779001234/smoothact-sq-128k/
anya: eval command i used:
```
python run_eval.py --model rlf-13b-sq-awq --context 131072 --quant awq --smoothact 0.5 --batch 1 --promptset longctx_math.json --out results.json
```
liam: what metrics did you track? ppl/bleu/qa-acc?
anya: tracked: ppl (lm), exact_match on recall prompts, numeric-math accuracy (3-digit), and latency/p99. quick summary: FP32 baseline ppl=2.3, FP8 ppl=2.45 (+6.5%), AWQ-int8 ppl=2.9 (+26%), GPTQ ppl=3.1 (+35%). recall EM: baseline 92.1%, FP8 90.8%, AWQ-int8 82.4%, GPTQ 78.9%. math accuracy: baseline 88.3%, FP8 85.6%, AWQ-int8 69.2%, GPTQ 64.7%.
sam: wow that int8 drop is big. any patterns in sequence position? start vs tail? memory/KV cache issues?
anya: yes — most errors concentrate after ~30k tokens, and across sequences with many numeric tokens (tables, code). KV cache looks intact but attention scaling seems to accumulate small biases. FP8 exhibits occasional output token jitter but stays close. AWQ/int8 heavily degrades on mantissa-sensitive ops.
quant-bot: regression-checker: 3 prompts exceeded delta threshold (>10% EM) — ids: 4482, 4489, 4521. full diffs in artifacts.
devon: can you paste the act-shift and per-layer scale settings you used? also did you try activation-aware smoothing (act-shift=0.8) vs default?
anya: settings: smoothact=0.5, activation_shift_mode=per_channel (enabled), clip=0.02. I ran an ablation on shift: 0.3/0.5/0.8 — 0.8 reduced tail regressions by ~40% for AWQ but increased ppl by ~2% vs 0.5.
liam: any perf numbers? throughput and GPU mem for 128k?
anya: throughput: FP32 ~ 55 tokens/s on a8g-large(Amphora) (single stream), FP8 ~ 74 tok/s, AWQ-int8 ~ 112 tok/s (but more variance), GPTQ ~ 128 tok/s. GPU mem peak: FP32 62GB, FP8 46GB, AWQ-int8 28GB. note: AWQ pins some activations to CPU when context>64k leading to tail latency spikes.
sam: could the CPU fallback explain the accuracy drift (serialization or dtype casts)?
anya: plausible — saw repeated float->int conversions on the head layers where attention scores are highest. need to instrument cast points.
devon: re-run suggestion: try hybrid quant (FP8 for attention + AWQ-int8 for feedforward) and act-shift=0.8, cap kv-cache chunking to 16k. can we schedule that tomorrow?
anya: scheduling a 6h slot tonight. will push a branch with changes and a smaller smoke with seed prompts first.
liam: add a targeted eval for arithmetic chains and tabular recall — those are the worst offenders.
anya: will add promptsets: longctx_arith.json and longctx_tables.json.
quant-bot: FYI: flagged run 1779020001 as matching hybrid config template.
devon: perfect. :thumbsup:
anya: short log excerpt: ```
[INFO] model loaded rlf-13b-sq-awq | quant=awq | smoothact=0.5
[INFO] context=131072 | prompts=120 | avg_prompt_len=88000
[WARN] layer 22 numeric overflow corrected by clip=0.02
[ERROR] prompt 4489 mismatch: expected 45123 got 45120
```
any other suggestions?
sam: instrument dtype transitions and add per-layer abs-scale histograms. also test blockwise kv caching with 32k blocks.
anya: good call — I'll collect histograms and post results.
liam: thanks — great triage. we'll reconvene after the hybrid runs.
anya: thanks all.
